ayahs.arabicText: الٓمّٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: غُلِبَتِ الرُّوْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: The Romans have been defeated

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْۤ اَدْنَى الْاَرْضِ وَ هُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَیَغْلِبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: in the neighbouring land; but after their defeat they shall gain victory in a few years.

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْ بِضْعِ سِنِیْنَ١ؕ۬ لِلّٰهِ الْاَمْرُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ مِنْۢ بَعْدُ١ؕ وَ یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: All power belongs to Allah both before and after. On that day will the believers rejoice

ayahs.arabicText: بِنَصْرِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ یَنْصُرُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: at the victory granted by Allah. He grants victory to whomsoever He pleases. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ لَا یُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهٗ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: This is Allah's promise and He does not go back on His promise. But most people do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُوْنَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۖۚ وَ هُمْ عَنِ الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَتَفَكَّرُوْا فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ١۫ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى١ؕ وَ اِنَّ كَثِیْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not reflect on themselves? Allah created the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them in Truth and for an appointed term. Yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَیَنْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ كَانُوْۤا اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَّ اَثَارُوا الْاَرْضَ وَ عَمَرُوْهَاۤ اَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوْهَا وَ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ١ؕ فَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِیَظْلِمَهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ كَانُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ یَظْلِمُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Have they not travelled through the earth that they may observe what was the end of their predecessors who were far mightier and tilled the land and built upon it more than these have ever built? And Allah's Messengers came to them with Clear Signs. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but it is they who wronged themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِیْنَ اَسَآءُوا السُّوْٓاٰۤى اَنْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَ كَانُوْا بِهَا یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Evil was the end of those evil-doers, for they gave the lie to Allah's Signs and scoffed at them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ یَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُهٗ ثُمَّ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah creates in the first instance and will later repeat it. Thereafter it is to Him that you shall be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ یُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass, the criminals shall be dumbfounded.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعٰٓؤُا وَ كَانُوْا بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: None whom they had associated with Allah in His Divinity will intercede on their behalf; rather, they will disown those whom they had set up as Allah's associates in His Divinity.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّتَفَرَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass, people will be split into groups.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَهُمْ فِیْ رَوْضَةٍ یُّحْبَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ لِقَآئِ الْاٰخِرَةِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ فِی الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs and to the encounter of the Hereafter, they will be arraigned for chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِیْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَ حِیْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So glorify Allah in the evening and the morning.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ عَشِیًّا وَّ حِیْنَ تُظْهِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: His is all praise in the heavens and in the earth; (and glorify Him) in the afternoon and when the sun begins to decline.

ayahs.arabicText: یُخْرِجُ الْحَیَّ مِنَ الْمَیِّتِ وَ یُخْرِجُ الْمَیِّتَ مِنَ الْحَیِّ وَ یُحْیِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا١ؕ وَ كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and revives the earth after it is dead. Likewise will you be raised to life (after you die).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖۤ اَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ اِذَاۤ اَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that He created you from dust and behold, you became human beings, and are multiplying around (the earth).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖۤ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْۤا اِلَیْهَا وَ جَعَلَ بَیْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّ رَحْمَةً١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that He has created mates for you from your own kind that you may find peace in them and He has set between you love and mercy. Surely there are Signs in this for those who reflect.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ اخْتِلَافُ اَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَ اَلْوَانِكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّلْعٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your tongues and colours. Indeed there are Signs in this for the wise.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِالَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ وَ ابْتِغَآؤُكُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is your sleeping at night and your seeking His Bounty during the day. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who hearken.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ یُرِیْكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَّ طَمَعًا وَّ یُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَیُحْیٖ بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that He shows you lightning, arousing both fear and hope, and sends down water from the sky and revives the earth after it is dead. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖۤ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ السَّمَآءُ وَ الْاَرْضُ بِاَمْرِهٖ١ؕ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً١ۖۗ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ١ۖۗ اِذَاۤ اَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that the sky and the earth stand firm by His command. Then no sooner than He summons you out of the earth you will come forth.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهٗ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: To Him belong all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. All are in obedience to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ یَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُهٗ وَ هُوَ اَهْوَنُ عَلَیْهِ١ؕ وَ لَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰى فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ۚ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who creates in the first instance and it is He Who will repeat the creation, and that is easier for Him. His is the loftiest attribute in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَّثَلًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ١ؕ هَلْ لَّكُمْ مِّنْ مَّا مَلَكَتْ اَیْمَانُكُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَآءَ فِیْ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ فَاَنْتُمْ فِیْهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُوْنَهُمْ كَخِیْفَتِكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰیٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ یَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He sets forth for you a parable from your own lives. Do you have among your slaves some who share with you the sustenance that We have bestowed on you so that you become equals in it, all being alike, and then you would hold them in fear as you fear each other? Thus do We make plain the Signs for those who use reason.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ بِغَیْرِ عِلْمٍ١ۚ فَمَنْ یَّهْدِیْ مَنْ اَضَلَّ اللّٰهُ١ؕ وَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But the wrong-doers follow their desires without any knowledge. Who, then, can show the way to him whom Allah lets go astray? Such shall have no helpers.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّیْنِ حَنِیْفًا١ؕ فِطْرَتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِیْ فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَیْهَا١ؕ لَا تَبْدِیْلَ لِخَلْقِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّیْنُ الْقَیِّمُ١ۙۗ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَۗۙ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet and his followers), turn your face singlemindedly to the true Faith and adhere to the true nature on which Allah has created human beings. The mould fashioned by Allah cannot be altered. That is the True, Straight Faith, although most people do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: مُنِیْبِیْنَ اِلَیْهِ وَ اتَّقُوْهُ وَ اَقِیْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ لَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Adhere to the True Faith and) turn to Him, and hold Him in awe, and establish Prayer, and do not be of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity,

ayahs.arabicText: مِنَ الَّذِیْنَ فَرَّقُوْا دِیْنَهُمْ وَ كَانُوْا شِیَعًا١ؕ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَیْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: those who have split up their religion and have become divided into sects, each party exulting in what they have.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُّنِیْبِیْنَ اِلَیْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَاۤ اَذَاقَهُمْ مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً اِذَا فَرِیْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ یُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Such are human beings) that when any misfortune befalls them, they cry to their Lord, penitently turning to Him. But no sooner that He lets them have a taste of His Mercy than some of them begin associating others with their Lord in His Divinity

ayahs.arabicText: لِیَكْفُرُوْا بِمَاۤ اٰتَیْنٰهُمْ١ؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوْا١ٙ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So, enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ سُلْطٰنًا فَهُوَ یَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَاۤ اَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْا بِهَا١ؕ وَ اِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَیِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَیْدِیْهِمْ اِذَا هُمْ یَقْنَطُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy, they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds, then lo and behold, they despair.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ وَ یَقْدِرُ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاٰتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَ الْمِسْكِیْنَ وَ ابْنَ السَّبِیْلِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ خَیْرٌ لِّلَّذِیْنَ یُرِیْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِ١٘ وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So give his due to the near of kin, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اٰتَیْتُمْ مِّنْ رِّبًا لِّیَرْبُوَاۡ فِیْۤ اَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا یَرْبُوْا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ١ۚ وَ مَاۤ اٰتَیْتُمْ مِّنْ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِیْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give, seeking with it Allah's good pleasure, that is multiplied manifold.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ یُمِیْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ یُحْیِیْكُمْ١ؕ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَآئِكُمْ مَّنْ یَّفْعَلُ مِنْ ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created you, then bestowed upon you your sustenance, and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity! do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.

ayahs.arabicText: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِی الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَیْدِی النَّاسِ لِیُذِیْقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِیْ عَمِلُوْا لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men's deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ سِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُ١ؕ كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّشْرِكِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), say: “Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّیْنِ الْقَیِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَ یَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّصَّدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted, the Day when people will split into groups.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَیْهِ كُفْرُهٗ١ۚ وَ مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِاَنْفُسِهِمْ یَمْهَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously, they will pave the way for their own good

ayahs.arabicText: لِیَجْزِیَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا یُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: so that Allah may, out of His Bounty, reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖۤ اَنْ یُّرْسِلَ الرِّیَاحَ مُبَشِّرٰتٍ وَّ لِیُذِیْقَكُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِهٖ وَ لِتَجْرِیَ الْفُلْكُ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy, and that ships may sail at His bidding, and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوْهُمْ بِالْبَیِّنٰتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِیْنَ اَجْرَمُوْا١ؕ وَ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَیْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations, and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ یُرْسِلُ الرِّیٰحَ فَتُثِیْرُ سَحَابًا فَیَبْسُطُهٗ فِی السَّمَآءِ كَیْفَ یَشَآءُ وَ یَجْعَلُهٗ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلٰلِهٖ١ۚ فَاِذَاۤ اَصَابَ بِهٖ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖۤ اِذَا هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments, whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases, and lo, they rejoice at it,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یُّنَزَّلَ عَلَیْهِمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَمُبْلِسِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: although before that they were given to despair.

ayahs.arabicText: فَانْظُرْ اِلٰۤى اٰثٰرِ رَحْمَتِ اللّٰهِ كَیْفَ یُحْیِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا١ؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْیِ الْمَوْتٰى١ۚ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: See, then, the tokens of Allah's Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَرْسَلْنَا رِیْحًا فَرَاَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ یَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow, they would never cease to disbelieve.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰى وَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ بِهٰدِ الْعُمْیِ عَنْ ضَلٰلَتِهِمْ١ؕ اِنْ تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَنْ یُّؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَا فَهُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ ضُؔعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ضُؔعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضُؔعْفًا وَّ شَیْبَةً١ؕ یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ١ۚ وَ هُوَ الْعَلِیْمُ الْقَدِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength, then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ یُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ١ۙ۬ مَا لَبِثُوْا غَیْرَ سَاعَةٍ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْا یُؤْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَ الْاِیْمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِیْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ١٘ فَهٰذَا یَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَ لٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say: “According to Allah's Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now, this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَیَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا یَنْفَعُ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَ لَا هُمْ یُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them, nor will they be asked to make amends.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِیْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ١ؕ وَ لَئِنْ جِئْتَهُمْ بِاٰیَةٍ لَّیَقُوْلَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا مُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: In the Qur'an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them, those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say: “You are given to falsehood.”

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ یَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّ لَا یَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُوْقِنُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Therefore, (O Prophet), have patience. Surely Allah's promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.
